harness._note: The per-agent harness is auto-detected. showrunner ASKS it which files are rules and whether a worktree matches its parent — it keeps no list of its own. Track the harness dir in git (simplest: it then crosses into every worktree by itself), or set "installer" to the path of its install script so each worktree is provisioned with the PARENT's rules. Never let a worktree get freshly-seeded rules: an installer seeds user-owned files only when absent, so a blank verify.yaml means a commit gate that owes nothing and reports success.

resources.name: jaspr-build-port
resources.note: Port 5567. jaspr_cli 0.23.2 hardcodes serverProxyPort='5567' in lib/src/project.dart and build_command.dart binds it unconditionally; only `jaspr dev`/`serve` expose --proxy-port, `jaspr build` has no flag for it. apps/docs/test/build_smoke_test.dart runs a real jaspr build, so it inherits that port. A git worktree does not isolate a port, so two docs Crawlers -- or one Crawler and a dev server left running in the primary checkout -- collide, and the loser dies in setUpAll with 'Address already in use, errno = 48' while the build itself reports success. Observed 2026-08-29: crawler-docs-voice was blocked at its commit gate by the orchestrator's own `jaspr serve`, diagnosed it correctly, and had no lock to take because this list was empty.
